svg.aria-label: Highlights. 1st NeurIPS 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: Our household-robot team, The North Star, won it after placing 4th in 2025. 1M+ daily users at Upwork: My team's post-trained LLM writes job posts in Upwork's AI agent, replacing a paid API model. 13 papers and preprints: On LLM post-training and evaluation, robot VLAs and world models, and 6D pose estimation. 3 patents filed: On robot VLAs, world models and 3D vision, filed during my time at Huawei Noah's Ark Lab.
